dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「おや、朝倉。いいところにいるじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Ooh, Asakura. Right place, right time."
dialogues.text: "Ooh, Asakura. Right place, right time."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そ、その声は……」
dialogues.en: "T, that voice..."
dialogues.text: "T, that voice..."

dialogues.jp:
物理教室での授業の帰りに、あまり聞きたくな
い声に呼び止められた。
dialogues.en:
Returning to the physics classroom, a voice I didn't want to
hear, stopped me in my tracks.
dialogues.text:
Returning to the physics classroom, a voice I didn't want to
hear, stopped me in my tracks.

dialogues.jp:
「これは、白河先生じゃないですか？　こんち
　またご機嫌麗しゅう……」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, if it isn't Shirakawa-sensei? You're looking even more
beautiful than usual."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, if it isn't Shirakawa-sensei? You're looking even more
beautiful than usual."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「思ってもない台詞なんか口にしなくていいよ。
　言うだけ無駄だっての」
dialogues.en:
"Don't bother flattering me. I can tell that's not what
you're thinking."
dialogues.text:
"Don't bother flattering me. I can tell that's not what
you're thinking."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「で、何の用ッスか？」
dialogues.en: "Guh... what do you need me for?"
dialogues.text: "Guh... what do you need me for?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、そうそう。この前のテストの点数につ
　いてちょっと話がしたいと思いましてな」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, right right. I want to talk to you about your score for
the recent test."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, right right. I want to talk to you about your score for
the recent test."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生が、にやぁとイヤな笑いを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei's smile was frightening.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei's smile was frightening.

dialogues.jp: 「この前のテストって言うと期末テストですな」
dialogues.en: "By recent tests, you mean the end-of-term exams?"
dialogues.text: "By recent tests, you mean the end-of-term exams?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そう。ほら、結構面白い点数だったろ？　ど
　うしたらあんな点数が取れるのか、教えてほ
　しくてさ」
dialogues.en:
"Correct. It's a very... amazing score, you see? That's why
I'm so... interested to find out how you managed it."
dialogues.text:
"Correct. It's a very... amazing score, you see? That's why
I'm so... interested to find out how you managed it."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は、とたんに悪鬼のような表情をし、生
物準備室まで来るよう言い渡された。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei, looking like the spitting image of a devil,
gestured me into the biology room.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei, looking like the spitting image of a devil,
gestured me into the biology room.

dialogues.jp:
逮捕状はあるのかと言いたいところだが、たぶ
ん、あたしが法律だ！　と返されるだろう。
dialogues.en:
I was about to protest that it felt like I was getting
arrested, but then, she'd probably reply with "I AM the
law!".
dialogues.text:
I was about to protest that it felt like I was getting
arrested, but then, she'd probably reply with "I AM the
law!".

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あのさぁ、７点ってなんだよ。７点て」
dialogues.en: "You got 7 marks. 7 out of friggin 100."
dialogues.text: "You got 7 marks. 7 out of friggin 100."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いやぁ、ほら縁起がいいと思って」
dialogues.en: "H, hey, 7 is a lucky number, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "H, hey, 7 is a lucky number, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあなにかい？　アンタは狙ってこの点数
　を取ったと言いたい訳だ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh really? Are you trying to say you were aiming to get 7
marks?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh really? Are you trying to say you were aiming to get 7
marks?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そういうこと……ですかね」
dialogues.en: "Well, you could... say that."
dialogues.text: "Well, you could... say that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ふざけんじゃないっての……。そんなこと言
　うなら、７７点取れっての」
dialogues.en:
"Don't try to fool me... if that was true, you'd have gone
for 77 marks at least."
dialogues.text:
"Don't try to fool me... if that was true, you'd have gone
for 77 marks at least."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いや、ほら、潔さってあるじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "But, well, that isn't a manly score!"
dialogues.text: "But, well, that isn't a manly score!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「潔さねぇ。じゃあ、今度は狙って１００点取っ
　もらいたいもんだねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Manly, huh. Do you know what I think is manly? 100 marks.
You'd be aiming for that next time, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Manly, huh. Do you know what I think is manly? 100 marks.
You'd be aiming for that next time, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いやぁ、ははは……」
dialogues.en: "W, well, ahahaha...."
dialogues.text: "W, well, ahahaha...."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「その方がよっぽど縁起がいいと思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"And I'd say that number is luckier than any I can think
of."
dialogues.text:
"And I'd say that number is luckier than any I can think
of."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "T, that's true..."
dialogues.text: "T, that's true..."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は、ニヤリと笑って、座ったまま俺の腹
にパンチを入れてきた。
dialogues.en:
I was reeling from the verbal punches she was giving me,
while she simply sat there and grinned.
dialogues.text:
I was reeling from the verbal punches she was giving me,
while she simply sat there and grinned.

dialogues.jp: ──コンコン
dialogues.en: --*knock knock*
dialogues.text: --*knock knock*

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はぁい、空いてるよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not locked, come in."
dialogues.text: "It's not locked, come in."

dialogues.jp:
カラカラと扉が開き、２年生の女の子が入って
きた。
dialogues.en: The rusty door squeaked open, revealing a 2nd-year girl.
dialogues.text: The rusty door squeaked open, revealing a 2nd-year girl.

dialogues.jp: よく見ると、それは、
dialogues.en: Taking a closer look, it was,
dialogues.text: Taking a closer look, it was,

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「おや、月城じゃないか。どうしたんだい？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Tsukishiro. Do you need something?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Tsukishiro. Do you need something?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……呼ばれたので」
dialogues.en: "...You called for me."
dialogues.text: "...You called for me."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「え、ああ、そうか。いつでもいいからおいでっ
　て言ったんだっけ。ごめんごめん」
dialogues.en:
"Eh, ahh, that's right. I asked you to come when you were
free. Sorry, sorry."
dialogues.text:
"Eh, ahh, that's right. I asked you to come when you were
free. Sorry, sorry."

dialogues.jp: 月城は準備室に入ると、静かに扉を閉めた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro quietly entered the room, closing the door behind
her.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro quietly entered the room, closing the door behind
her.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「これは……あたしが言うことじゃないかも知
　れないけど、ちょっと気になったからさ」
dialogues.en:
"This is about... I don't know whether it's my place to be
saying this, but I'm worried about it."
dialogues.text:
"This is about... I don't know whether it's my place to be
saying this, but I'm worried about it."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生は、そう言って軽く咳払いをする。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei cleared her throat lightly.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei cleared her throat lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あのさ、お前が大切に持ってるその人形な、
　大切なのはわかるけれど、授業中もずっと
　持ったままってのはどうかと思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, Tsukishiro, about that doll... I know it's very
important to you, but you shouldn't be holding it during
classes..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, Tsukishiro, about that doll... I know it's very
important to you, but you shouldn't be holding it during
classes..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……大切なんです」
dialogues.en: "...It's special."
dialogues.text: "...It's special."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、わかるけどさ。学校は遊び場じゃない
　んだ。その辺のけじめっていうのをつけるべ
　きだと思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, I know that. But school isn't the same as a
playground. You have to realize the differences between the
two."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, I know that. But school isn't the same as a
playground. You have to realize the differences between the
two."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ピロスは、大切だから」
dialogues.en: "...Piros... is important."
dialogues.text: "...Piros... is important."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「月城……あのな」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro... you know, if..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro... you know, if..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「って、まぁまぁ。月城だって、次から気をつ
　けるって言ってるし」
dialogues.en:
"W, well well. Tsukishiro, what she's trying to say, is to
be more careful about that in the future."
dialogues.text:
"W, well well. Tsukishiro, what she's trying to say, is to
be more careful about that in the future."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「は？　そんなこと、一言も言って……」
dialogues.en: "Hah? Since when was I..."
dialogues.text: "Hah? Since when was I..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ほらほら、月城。気をつけるよな！　気をつ
　けるっていっとけ。この人は怖い人だ。逆ら
　うと人体実験の材料にされちまうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, Tsukishiro, just be careful next time! And hurry
up out of here. This woman is scary. She'd use you for her
experiements..."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, Tsukishiro, just be careful next time! And hurry
up out of here. This woman is scary. She'd use you for her
experiements..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、お前な……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, you..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, you..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……気を、つけます」
dialogues.en: "...I will be careful."
dialogues.text: "...I will be careful."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ね、先生。月城もああ言ってることだし」
dialogues.en: "See, sensei. She said it herself."
dialogues.text: "See, sensei. She said it herself."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……あんたってヤツは」
dialogues.en: "...You're such a busybody."
dialogues.text: "...You're such a busybody."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生は俺を｛にら／睨｝みつけ、懐のタバコを漁る。
dialogues.en:
Glaring at me, Koyomi-sensei started fishing for a cigarette
in her pockets.
dialogues.text:
Glaring at me, Koyomi-sensei started fishing for a cigarette
in her pockets.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「月城。もういい。ちゃんと気をつけるんだよ。
　お前もいつまでも子どもじゃないんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro, that's enough. You can go now. Just be careful
about that from now on. You won't be a kid forever."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro, that's enough. You can go now. Just be careful
about that from now on. You won't be a kid forever."

dialogues.jp:
月城はそう言ってぺこりと頭を下げると、来た
時と同じように静かに出て行った。
dialogues.en:
Upon hearing Koyomi's words, she nodded respectfully, then
left as quietly as she came.
dialogues.text:
Upon hearing Koyomi's words, she nodded respectfully, then
left as quietly as she came.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ふぅと胸を撫で下ろす。
dialogues.en: I sighed, rubbing my chest.
dialogues.text: I sighed, rubbing my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、あんたいったい何のつもりだい？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, what do you think you were doing there?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura, what do you think you were doing there?"

dialogues.jp:
カチリと音がして、部屋中にオイルとタバコの
匂いが充満する。
dialogues.en:
At the sound of the door being shut tightly, the room was
instantly overcome with the mixed scent of oil and cigarette
smoke.
dialogues.text:
At the sound of the door being shut tightly, the room was
instantly overcome with the mixed scent of oil and cigarette
smoke.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、あの人形はダメですよ……。月城にとっ
　ちゃ、すごく大事なものなんすから」
dialogues.en:
"It's just that, you can't stop her from holding that
doll... it's very very important to her."
dialogues.text:
"It's just that, you can't stop her from holding that
doll... it's very very important to her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしだって知ってるよ。大事じゃなかった
　ら、あんなに持ち歩かないだろうよ」
dialogues.en:
"I know that too. If it wasn't so important, she wouldn't be
carying it around that much."
dialogues.text:
"I know that too. If it wasn't so important, she wouldn't be
carying it around that much."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なら、わざわざ呼び出して、注意することは
　ないんじゃ……」
dialogues.en:
"Then, you didn't have to expressedly call her just to warn
her about that..."
dialogues.text:
"Then, you didn't have to expressedly call her just to warn
her about that..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「講師があたしだけなら、別にいいけどさ。あ
　あいうのを毛嫌いする先生もいるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"If I wasn't a teacher, I wouldn't mind either. I'm not that
horrible a sensei, you know."
dialogues.text:
"If I wasn't a teacher, I wouldn't mind either. I'm not that
horrible a sensei, you know."

dialogues.jp:
２〜３回、大きく吸うと先生はタバコを灰皿に
憎々しげに押しつけて消す。
dialogues.en:
2~3 clouds of smoke were puffed out from her mouth,
eventually disappearing in the air.
dialogues.text:
2~3 clouds of smoke were puffed out from her mouth,
eventually disappearing in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あんた、何か知ってるのかい？」
dialogues.en: "What do you know about this?"
dialogues.text: "What do you know about this?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、俺は月城とは、ちょっと話をしたこと
　がある程度だし……」
dialogues.en:
"Not much, Tsukishiro and I have just talked about that a
little..."
dialogues.text:
"Not much, Tsukishiro and I have just talked about that a
little..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、どうしてあの子の肩を持つんだい？
　あたしが知ってる範囲だとあんたと月城の
　接点は無いに等しいんだがね」
dialogues.en:
"Well then, what is her reason exactly for that? My extent
of knowledge of that is limited to the whats, and not the
whys."
dialogues.text:
"Well then, what is her reason exactly for that? My extent
of knowledge of that is limited to the whats, and not the
whys."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……いろいろあるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "...It's quite complicated."
dialogues.text: "...It's quite complicated."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そーかい、そーかい。じゃ、あの子になにか
　あったら、朝倉が責任を持つって事だね」
dialogues.en:
"I see, I see. In that case, if anything happens to her,
you'd be responsible."
dialogues.text:
"I see, I see. In that case, if anything happens to her,
you'd be responsible."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Huh, me!?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, me!?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そういうことだろ？　今の行動は」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that true? Look at what you just did."
dialogues.text: "Isn't that true? Look at what you just did."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生がにや〜っと笑いながら、俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
With a wide grin on her face, Koyomi-sensei was looking at
me.
dialogues.text:
With a wide grin on her face, Koyomi-sensei was looking at
me.

dialogues.jp: 最初からわかっているのだ、この人は！
dialogues.en: This must have been her plan from the start, this...!
dialogues.text: This must have been her plan from the start, this...!

dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃなぁ、そういうの……」
dialogues.en: "But that's so troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "But that's so troublesome..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ぼやくな。あたしだってあの子のことは、前
　からなんとかしてやりたかったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Stop your whining. I've always been worried about that kid
since the day she enrolled into this school."
dialogues.text:
"Stop your whining. I've always been worried about that kid
since the day she enrolled into this school."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「見るからに、いつも独りぼっちだし、他人と
　話をするのもうまくない」
dialogues.en:
"Everytime I see her, she's alone. She never seems to talk
to anyone."
dialogues.text:
"Everytime I see her, she's alone. She never seems to talk
to anyone."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「けど、講師という立場もあってか、あの子は
　あたしを受け入れちゃくれない」
dialogues.en:
"I would try to do something, but I'm a teacher. There's are
barriers that aren't easy for her or myself to get around."
dialogues.text:
"I would try to do something, but I'm a teacher. There's are
barriers that aren't easy for her or myself to get around."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、俺だって、ほとんど口は聞いてもらえ
　ないッスからね」
dialogues.en: "Well, in truth, she doesn't really tell me much either."
dialogues.text: "Well, in truth, she doesn't really tell me much either."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「最近は、天枷がちょっかい出してるのをよく
　見るから、うまく友達になれるといいと思う
　んだけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Recently, it seems that Amakase has been attempting to talk
to her, perhaps to make friends with her. That would be
good."
dialogues.text:
"Recently, it seems that Amakase has been attempting to talk
to her, perhaps to make friends with her. That would be
good."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「月城は……友達はあの人形だけしかいないっ
　て言ってますからね」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro said... that the only friend she has, is that
doll."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro said... that the only friend she has, is that
doll."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「噂だと、あの人形を使った腹話術で話したり
　もするらしいじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"From the rumours I've heard, doesn't that doll talk thanks
to her ventriloquism?"
dialogues.text:
"From the rumours I've heard, doesn't that doll talk thanks
to her ventriloquism?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、そうですね。やたらとうまいですけど」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that bit is accurate, at least."
dialogues.text: "Yes, that bit is accurate, at least."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あの子はきっと何かが欠けてるんだ。だから
　朝倉にはそれを埋めてやって欲しい」
dialogues.en:
"That girl definitely needs someone by her side right now.
That's why I want you to be that someone for her."
dialogues.text:
"That girl definitely needs someone by her side right now.
That's why I want you to be that someone for her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「んなこと言われましても……」
dialogues.en: "Even if you say that, she..."
dialogues.text: "Even if you say that, she..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、堅っ苦しく考える必要はないだろうよ。
　そんな気持ちで接すれば、あの子は一言も口
　を聞いてくれなくなるだろうから」
dialogues.en:
"Hah, there's no need to think so long and hard about it.
Even if you do, that girl won't say one thing about it
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Hah, there's no need to think so long and hard about it.
Even if you do, that girl won't say one thing about it
anyway."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生が、けらけらと笑う。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei laughed a little.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei laughed a little.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あんたには、あんたのできることがある。気
　が向いた時にそれをすればいいのさ。自分だっ
　てわかってるはずだ」
dialogues.en:
"There are things that you can do. Sooner or later, they
will come up, and you'll understand."
dialogues.text:
"There are things that you can do. Sooner or later, they
will come up, and you'll understand."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「気が向いた時ね……」
dialogues.en: "Sooner or later, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Sooner or later, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。なんにしたって、構えてすることじゃ
　あないからね」
dialogues.en: "Mmm. I don't think it's something you can force to happen."
dialogues.text: "Mmm. I don't think it's something you can force to happen."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、俺としても、月城はなんだか放っておけ
　ないっていうか……そういうヤツなんすよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, both ways... I'm not the kind of person who can just
leave someone like Tsukishiro alone either."
dialogues.text:
"Well, both ways... I'm not the kind of person who can just
leave someone like Tsukishiro alone either."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ふふ、それでいいよ。──ところで、朝倉。
　メシはまだかい？　まだなら、おごってやる
　ぞ？　学食でよければ」
dialogues.en:
"Haha, that'd be just fine. --Anyway, Asakura. Have you
eaten yet? If you haven't, how about lunch at the cafeteria?
My treat."
dialogues.text:
"Haha, that'd be just fine. --Anyway, Asakura. Have you
eaten yet? If you haven't, how about lunch at the cafeteria?
My treat."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ま、マジっすか？」
dialogues.en: "S, seriously?"
dialogues.text: "S, seriously?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、たまにはいいだろ。ホントは、特定の
　学生にこういうことやっちゃいけないんだけ
　どな」
dialogues.en:
"Yup, it's fine once in a while. After all, You're not a
typical student to me."
dialogues.text:
"Yup, it's fine once in a while. After all, You're not a
typical student to me."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は、そう言って、大げさにウインクをし
て見せた。
dialogues.en: As she spoke, she winked at me.
dialogues.text: As she spoke, she winked at me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「テストの点数は……７点しか取れないが、他
　の部分でいい点数取ってるからな。あたしか
　らのサービスだ」
dialogues.en:
"And about the test scores... I can't change the 7 mark one,
but I'd make sure you do well on the others. Treat it as
service."
dialogues.text:
"And about the test scores... I can't change the 7 mark one,
but I'd make sure you do well on the others. Treat it as
service."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、年甲斐もなく『よっこいせ』など
と口にして立ち上がる先生。
dialogues.en:
With a noise undeserving of her age, she then lifted herself
off her chair, and stood up.
dialogues.text:
With a noise undeserving of her age, she then lifted herself
off her chair, and stood up.

dialogues.jp: 他の部分のいい点数って、──なんなんだ？
dialogues.en: Make sure I do well on the others... eh?
dialogues.text: Make sure I do well on the others... eh?

dialogues.jp: ま、おごってもらえるなら、なんでもいいや。
dialogues.en: Well, I'm getting treated anyway, so who cares.
dialogues.text: Well, I'm getting treated anyway, so who cares.

dialogues.jp: ◆それぞれのできること◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Thingss People Can Do◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Thingss People Can Do◆

dialogues.jp:
テストのことで暦先生に怒られていると、先生
に呼ばれたらしい月城が入ってきた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei was furious with me about the tests, but then
Tsukishiro interrupted us, apparently having been called up
before.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei was furious with me about the tests, but then
Tsukishiro interrupted us, apparently having been called up
before.

dialogues.jp:
先生は、月城の人形のことを注意するが、彼女
は大切なモノなのだと言い張り、暦先生を困ら
せていた。
dialogues.en:
Sensei wanted Tsukishiro to be more careful about where she
took the doll, despite it being important to her.
Koyomi-sensei was worried for her.
dialogues.text:
Sensei wanted Tsukishiro to be more careful about where she
took the doll, despite it being important to her.
Koyomi-sensei was worried for her.

dialogues.jp:
月城が帰った後、暦先生は俺に、自分は教師と
いう立場上、どうしても月城に受け入れてもら
えない部分があるとこぼす。
dialogues.en:
When Tsukishiro left, Koyomi-sensei told me that since she
was a teacher, there were boundaries between the two of them
that were hard to surpass.
dialogues.text:
When Tsukishiro left, Koyomi-sensei told me that since she
was a teacher, there were boundaries between the two of them
that were hard to surpass.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺に、月城と仲がいいのなら、ぜひ彼
女の力になってくれと言われるのだった。
dialogues.en:
So I was to be her pillar of strength, to support her when
she needs it.
dialogues.text:
So I was to be her pillar of strength, to support her when
she needs it.

dialogues.jp: 学食でのおごりと引き替えに。
dialogues.en:
I was treated to lunch at the caferteria, due to my
acceptance of her request.
dialogues.text:
I was treated to lunch at the caferteria, due to my
acceptance of her request.
